limits: Conservative table-local worker contract, not all-route readiness. All columns of directly used worker tables retained pending minimal-column review.

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_notif_jobs_dedup ON public.notification_jobs USING btree (tenant_id, deduplication_key) WHERE ((deduplication_key IS NOT NULL) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying])::text[])))
